panels.title: DFAIR Runner
panels.description: Container recently observed by cAdvisor (not GitHub runner registration state). One value: 1=UP, 0=DOWN.

panels.title: DFAIR Current Job
panels.description: Current job inferred from Docker runner logs via exporter on port 9119. Requires Prometheus scrape job gha-runner-jobs; absence of metrics means no data, not idle.

targets.expr: (gha_runner_current_job{runner="dfair"} == 1) or label_replace((gha_runner_job_observer_up{runner="dfair"} == 0) unless on(runner) gha_runner_current_job{runner="dfair"}, "job", "OBSERVER OFFLINE", "runner", ".*") or label_replace((gha_runner_job_observer_initialized{runner="dfair"} == 0) unless on(runner) gha_runner_current_job{runner="dfair"}, "job", "STATUS UNKNOWN", "runner", ".*") or label_replace((gha_runner_job_observer_initialized{runner="dfair"} == 1) unless on(runner) gha_runner_current_job{runner="dfair"}, "job", "None running", "runner", ".*")

panels.title: DFAIR Runner CPU
panels.description: Container CPU utilization divided by the GHA host logical CPU count; 100% corresponds to all host CPUs. Requires node-exporter gha-general-01-node metrics.

panels.title: DFAIR Runner RAM (% host)
panels.description: Container memory as a percentage of the physical memory reported by node-exporter for gha-general-01. Capacity adjusts with host RAM.

panels.title: DFAIR Runner Network throughput
panels.description: Current aggregate RX+TX in bytes/s. No fixed maximum because the NIC/link rate has not been verified. Host-networked KC may lack distinct cAdvisor network metrics.
